# Copilot review instructions

- Read `AGENTS.md`, `concept.md` and `TESTING.md` for the product rules and the test policy.
- Report only likely bugs, data-integrity or security problems, protocol or storage-contract violations, and missing tests for changed behavior. Skip style nits.
- Documentation, comments and PR text must be in English.
- Do not claim game, TruckersMP or performance compatibility from automated checks.
